description: The agent must: (1) Read SKILL.md to identify the 'Heavy User' schedule (8+ hours/day) with its exact three-tier intervals: eye break every 20 min, quick reset every 30 min, energy break every 60 min. (2) Generate a bash script with the exact proprietary configuration variable names from SKILL.md: EYE_INTERVAL=1200, STRETCH_INTERVAL=1800, LONG_BREAK_INTERVAL=3600, SOUND_ENABLED=true, NOTIFICATION_TYPE="all". (3) Use notify-send as the Linux notification tool per SKILL.md platform specification. (4) Embed exercise instructions for all three health areas: 20-20-20 eye care protocol, a named lower-back/spinal exercise (e.g., Seated Cat-Cow, Spinal Twist), and RSI/wrist prevention (e.g., Wrist Circles, Prayer Stretch). (5) Implement a continuous background loop with sleep intervals using the defined variables so the script can run as './ergocare_pro.sh &'. Agents relying on generic knowledge will fail on the exact variable names, precise interval values (1200/1800/3600), the specific Linux notification tool, and the requirement to embed named exercises from the skill's library.
